fullPassage: Emerging findings suggest that minorities arguing their point of view electronically can be influential in ways that improve group performance, as long as they claim in-group affiliation and maintain their views consistently. Several fascinating studies have also demonstrated a persuasive and performance advantage for remote or geographically removed minorities. In these cases, groups with a minority advocate who is geographically remote seemed to perform better because the minority was able to play devil’s advocate, effectively inducing the majority to think about alternatives. The clash between mainstream narratives and strongly-held minority opinions can rapidly escalate into widespread and toxic debates and conflicts online. Perhaps being removed from the anxiety and discomfort of face-to-face disagreements makes it easier for the minority to assert an atypical view without fear of reprisal, and makes it easier for majorities to accept minority input without worrying about the identity consequences of publicly accepting it. Thus, increased opportunity for minority points of view to improve group decisions should be counted among the benefits of electronic or technology-mediated communication.

questions.passage: Emerging findings suggest that minorities arguing their point of view electronically can be influential in ways that improve group performance, as long as they claim in-group affiliation and maintain their views __________. Several fascinating studies have also demonstrated a persuasive and performance advantage for remote or geographically removed minorities. In these cases, groups with a minority advocate who is geographically remote seemed to perform better because the minority was able to play devil’s advocate, effectively inducing the majority to think about alternatives. The clash between mainstream narratives and strongly-held minority opinions can rapidly escalate into widespread and toxic debates and conflicts online. Perhaps being removed from the anxiety and discomfort of face-to-face disagreements makes it easier for the minority to assert an atypical view without fear of reprisal, and makes it easier for majorities to accept minority input without worrying about the identity consequences of publicly accepting it. Thus, increased opportunity for minority points of view to improve group decisions should be counted among the benefits of electronic or technology-mediated communication.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
① occasionally(가끔, 때때로): 소수가 관점을 '가끔' 유지한다면 설득력을 잃으므로 문맥과 맞지 않음

② consistently(일관되게, 꾸준히): 소수가 영향력을 갖기 위해 관점을 '일관되게' 유지해야 한다는 문맥에 정확히 부합 ←정답

③ reluctantly(마지못해, 꺼려하며): 마지못해 유지한다는 것은 적극적 주장과 맞지 않음

④ secretly(비밀리에, 몰래): 비밀리에 유지하는 것은 공개적 주장의 맥락과 모순
det.tip: maintain their views consistently = 관점을 일관되게 유지하다

Several fascinating studies have also demonstrated a persuasive and performance advantage for remote or geographically removed minorities. In these cases, groups with a minority advocate who is geographically remote seemed to perform better because the minority was able to play devil’s advocate, effectively inducing the majority to think about alternatives. questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
① recognition(인정, 인식): '인정의 두려움 없이'라고 하면 소수가 인정받기를 두려워한다는 뜻이 되어 문맥과 맞지 않음

② promotion(승진, 촉진): '승진의 두려움'이라는 표현은 이 맥락에서 의미가 통하지 않음

③ approval(승인, 찬성): '승인의 두려움'은 긍정적 개념이어서 두려움의 대상이 될 수 없음

④ reprisal(보복, 앙갚음): 소수가 비전형적 관점을 '보복의 두려움 없이' 주장할 수 있다는 문맥에 정확히 부합 ←정답
det.tip: without fear of reprisal = 보복의 두려움 없이
